# Women in STEM at UT Austin

> WiSTEM is UT Austin's comprehensive initiative supporting women in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics through undergraduate programs, K-12 outreach, career development, and corporate partnerships.

Women in STEM (WiSTEM) at the University of Texas at Austin empowers female students and pre-college learners through residential communities, mentorship networks, externships, and volunteer leadership opportunities. The organization partners with major corporations and foundations to expand access to STEM education and career advancement.

## Key Topics

- Women in STEM (WiSTEM)
- UT Austin / Cockrell School of Engineering
- STEM Girl Day
- Living Learning Community
- K-12 outreach
- Career development
- Role Model Monday Webinars
- iConnect networking
- Student leadership
- Externship programs
- Corporate partnerships
- Volunteer opportunities
- Undergraduate support
- Pre-college STEM education
- Community engagement

## Undergraduate Programs

- [Undergraduate Programs – Women in STEM](https://womeninstem.utexas.edu/undergraduate-programs): WiSTEM undergraduate programs including Living Learning Community
- [Living Learning Community – Women in STEM](https://womeninstem.utexas.edu/living-learning-community): WiSTEM Living Learning Community residential program at UT Austin
- [iConnect – Women in STEM](https://womeninstem.utexas.edu/iconnect): WiSTEM iConnect career development and networking events program
- [Externship – Women in STEM](https://womeninstem.utexas.edu/externship): WiSTEM externship program with IBM SkillsBuild and digital badges
- [Student Leadership Ecosystem – Women in STEM](https://womeninstem.utexas.edu/student-leadership-ecosystem): WiSTEM student leadership training and development ecosystem
